scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @neocode/server" "npm run dev -w @neocode/web"
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:e2e: npm exec --workspace @neocode/web playwright install chromium && npm run test:e2e -w @neocode/web
scripts.check: npm run check:git && npm run check --workspaces --if-present
